name: ThinkLatent v11
note: Design kit colour v5 (design-kit v0.11.4), 23 Nov 2026, TL-016 D-490. Black is the theme's main colour, so every native SharePoint button is the kit's black everyday button. The colour pairs give page authors the three flat backgrounds; Meadow, the white hero with its one field, stays an image. Every value is a kit token.

siteBrandingRoute.note: For the site-owner route: Settings > Site branding > Theme > + New theme. Add the primary and the secondary colours with + Add color, then the three combinations with + New combination. Emerald #0B5F33 is added as a colour only, for labels in the Text web part; it is never a button colour, so it is in no combination.

paletteNote: Legacy format, only for a tenant whose SharePoint Online Management Shell has no -ColorPairs: run the script with -Legacy. With this palette SharePoint's section backgrounds are None (white), Neutral (#EFF2F0), Soft (#F7F8F7) and Strong (themePrimary, black); do not use Strong, and set the tints as images.
